column5: First version. The seven business columns are the signed off SDR version 1.2, unchanged. Eight technical columns added to the right of them.

Changed from a page load rule to a direct call. The product objects are filled by a script that runs after the page load rule fires, so the rule was sending an empty product on every product page. Nothing errored. The product report was simply thin and nobody could say why.
Custom code added to build the product string from the cart array. The first build sent one entry holding several IDs, which reported as a single product that does not exist.
Duplicate order guard added. Refreshing the confirmation page was sending a second purchase.
Null search condition rewritten. The result count arrives from the site as a string, so a comparison against the number zero never matched and no null search was ever recorded.
Consent gate added across every rule. Raised in review, not in the requirements.
Walked through with the development team. This is the version the build is being tested against.
